description: Kling Avatar (kling-ai-avatar-v2): the official capability map lists it as a model-version-independent base capability, so the catalog books it as a capability entry rather than a model-version entry. Official API is POST /v1/videos/avatar/image2video with image (required), audio_id or sound_file (mutually exclusive), prompt, and mode (std|pro, default std). The official price table quotes two columns for this row (0.4 and 0.8 units per second, the 4K column empty) matching the two modes; the official docs do not spell out which mode maps to 720P/1080P, so this catalog pairs them by official column order = ascending unit price = mode std then pro, and prices the mode as a dimension.
